To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the contextual knowledge representation, retrieval and interpretation techniques proposed in this paper can be used to support the semantic-based multimedia e-learning environment, and enable the semantic-based knowledge communication between instructors and learners.
a semantic-based multimedia knowledge communication and transfer model can be achieved with a set of novel knowledge discovery, representation, retrieval and interpretation techniques.

(a) the proposed knowledge representation model can support the knowledge communication model in university e-learning; (b) the proposed knowledge retrieval technique based on the knowledge representation model can help instructors to discover related knowledge and reuse it to support scenario-based learning in university e-learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and evaluation of a novel contextual knowledge representation, retrieval and interpretation approach for multimedia e-learning.
the development of a semantic context-aware knowledge representation model and its related knowledge discovery and interpretation techniques.
the development of a semantic-based knowledge management framework, which can be used for the development of a new generation of intelligent multimedia e-learning systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed framework is able to provide semantic knowledge representation, retrieval and interpretation in multimedia e-learning environments.
the proposed framework is able to improve the current e-learning status and enable a semantic based knowledge communication environment for instructors and learners.

the proposed contextual knowledge representation, retrieval and interpretation techniques can be applied in the context of multimedia e-learning to support the development of a semantic-based interactive e-learning environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, with our proposed model and techniques, a semantic-based knowledge representation and retrieval system is developed, which can support a more intelligent e-learning environment with context-aware knowledge communication and transfer.

a semantic-based e-learning environment is able to provide a more flexible, interactive, and personalized e-learning experience for instructors and learners, by supporting semantic knowledge discovery, communication and reuse.
we propose a semantic-based knowledge management framework for multimedia e-learning, and present a set of novel knowledge representation, retrieval and semantic interpretation techniques.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have presented a new framework and a set of novel knowledge representation and interpretation techniques towards semantic-based multimedia e-learning.
a semantic-based e-learning system can support more effective learning and knowledge management by providing contextualized learning knowledge representation, retrieval and interpretation.
a semantic context model is able to represent and interpret knowledge in multimedia e-learning environment.
